suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: A child is a young person.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: A language is a system of words or signs that people use to communicate.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: Hindi and English are languages used by many people in India.
suggestions.rationale: General communication-system sense fits foundational vocabulary better than speech-only or lyric senses.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: Popular means liked or enjoyed by many people.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: Cricket is a popular sport in India.

suggestions.proposedChildExample: We are visiting the library today.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: Cold means having a low temperature or feeling chilly.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: The water felt cold on my hands.
suggestions.rationale: Physical-temperature sense is concrete and avoids emotional or figurative meanings.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: An island is land with water all around it.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: The small island could be reached only by boat.
suggestions.rationale: Canonical geographic sense is unambiguous for primary learners.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: To remember means to bring something you know or experienced back into your mind.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: I remember where I left my pencil.
suggestions.rationale: Basic memory-recall sense is more foundational than reminder or reminiscence uses.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: To hold something means to keep it in your hands or arms.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: Hold the cup with both hands.
suggestions.rationale: Concrete grasping sense supports simple actions and instructions.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: To learn means to gain new knowledge or a new skill.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: We learn new words by reading stories.
suggestions.rationale: General knowledge-and-skill acquisition sense is foundational and broad.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: A woman is an adult who is female.
suggestions.proposedChildExample: The woman helped the children find their classroom.
suggestions.rationale: Basic adult-person sense avoids relationship-specific and collective-class meanings.

suggestions.proposedChildDefinition: A father is a male parent in a family.
